why: A = translation_isLocalScDiffeo_src/_tgt, translation_isScSmoothCompSheet, translation_isProperMap (every V) at universe 0, all for R : X.NaturalRep x (U connected); B asks, for every natural action with U merely open, for an EpGroupoid on (U, G_x × U) with the text's s, t, ∘ and the charts of restrictOpen U and discretePolyfold G_x × U. A cannot be applied to a disconnected U, so A_to_B does NOT use A: B is proved outright (B_holds) from the project's generic Examples.actionEpGroupoid (NonVacuity.lean, proved independently of the four theorems) — the ep-groupoid structure only needs Φ to be a finite group action by sc-diffeomorphisms (Φ(1) = id follows from injectivity), not Γ or connectedness; so the project's connectedness hypothesis is superfluous for this item.
